# Widget Forge

## Core Value

A synthetic GSD project used as a fixture: `.planning/` exists with only
`PROJECT.md`. No ROADMAP.md, no STATE.md, no phases/, no config.json.

## Problem

Exercises the `no phases planned` / GSD `needs-first-phase` branch of the
recommended-next rule table and the `health: ok` + empty-`phases[]` shape of
`ProjectSnapshot`.

## Scope

Fixture only. Contains no real project data.
